binding.cause: Three materialized R33 lifecycle-tool pins were wrongly inherited; original R34 installer rewrote two root constants and their manifest before any measurement.

compiler_monitor.statement_scope: 1 Hz metadata samples only; absence between observations is not proved

controller_rss.aggregation: maximum sampled controller RSS across all four native controllers per arm, including restarts

validation.scope: 1 Hz sampled observations, with bounded schedule and cost; unsampled activity is not ruled out

limitations: Only observed descendants of this controller; no remote/cluster CPU.
100 ms sampling can miss short-lived or reparented descendants.
RSS is a non-atomic sum and can double-count shared pages.
FD failure does not discard other metrics; all missing observations are in the trace.
SSH classification uses executable basename; generations changing class are mixed.
Lifetime CPU includes activity before first observation; interval deltas are diagnostic.
Sampler and transport capture run in the Python harness; their CPU is not controller CPU.

scope.causal_attribution: No causal diagnosis follows from this single original rejected campaign.

thresholds.cache_cap_evidence_scope: source and qualification; RSS gate measures the actual process
thresholds.rss_aggregation: maximum sampled controller RSS across all four native controllers per arm, including restarts
thresholds.rss_combination: both limits; B <= min(A + 512 KiB, A * 1.05)
